name: Bambowl
tagline: Recipes, meal plans and grocery lists, tidy and in one place.
description: Bambowl keeps your recipes, cookbooks, weekly meal plan and grocery list on your phone. Save a recipe from a website, a video's description or a post's caption, or a photo of a cookbook page, and Bambowl reads it into clean ingredients and steps.
Sign in with Google if you want your recipes on more than one phone. Everything else stays on the phone.
features: Import recipes from links (recipe sites, and the written description or caption of YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and Xiaohongshu posts) or photos, with the nutrition the site publishes
Cooking mode with step timers and hands-free voice control
Weekly meal plan and a smart grocery list, with My fridge: list what you have and see what each recipe is missing
"What can I cook?" from what's in your fridge, or search your recipes by ingredient
Friends and groups of up to 5: share recipes and chat

A daily gift, quests, achievements, events, redeem codes and a free season pass, Cosmetics of avatar frames, chat styles and collectibles, a Mail for gifts and news, and a Shop that takes only earned Bambits

collected.data: Name, email address and profile picture
Recipes, cookbooks, meal plans, grocery lists and what you list in My fridge
A small copy of each recipe's main photo
Messages and recipes you send to friends and groups

Bambits balance and history, daily gift streak and time zone, quest and achievement progress, the frames and chat styles you have and wear, what you buy in the Shop, the events you finish, codes you redeem, season pass rewards you claim, and the Mail Bambowl sends you (read and claimed)
collected.why: The daily gift, quests, achievements, events, redeem codes, the season pass, Mail, Cosmetics and the Shop
Alerts for messages, group invites and friend requests

collected.data: Reports you make about a person

sent.data: Your voice, while hands-free cooking is on
sent.to: Your phone's speech service, or Google's online speech service if you switch on “Hear me from further away”
sent.why: Hands-free cooking commands; not recorded or kept by Bambowl

dataSafety.deletion: In the app: Account › Google account › Delete my account. Or email us.
extras: Works without an account. Nothing is collected until you sign in.
No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

releases.notes: New looks for collectibles and bubbles, and more recipes to discover.
changes: Discover now picks from many more recipe sites, so fresh recipes come round more often
Boba Pal, Fortune Friend, Pudding Pal, Mochi Moon, Onigiri Smile and Tempura Tumble have been remade
Rainbow Ramen and Family Table frames have new animations made for their own art
Jade Dragon Scroll, Night Market Lanterns and Rainbow Broth bubbles have new art with their own glows and sparkles
Framed bubbles now fit the normal message size, and short messages stay clear of the decorations

releases.notes: Google sign-in now goes through Pandalume Studio's own sign-in page.
changes: Sign in with Google opens our own sign-in page, so Google's screen shows who is asking
Same Google account, same recipes, friends and Bambits: nothing to move, and you stay signed in
Cancelling on Google's screen simply brings you back to Bambowl

releases.notes: Activity and alerts for the Feed, plus fresher Discover picks and frame touch-ups.
changes: Activity: a bell at the top of Friends shows who reacted to or commented on your posts, and new ones count on the Friends tab
Get an alert when a friend shares a new post; switch it off for one friend in their profile (their messages still alert)
Mail › Activity also shows when there's something new on your posts
Reactions under a post sit snugly together, and your Account page shows your picture in the frame you wear
Discover's "5 ingredients or less" and Drinks rows change more often, with fewer repeats
The Jade Dragon and Night Market frames have a wider mist; Night Market's is now a night-blue glow
More reliable on patchy connections: actions no longer hang after the app has been idle for a while

releases.notes: A Feed for friends: share what you cooked, react, comment and edit your posts.
changes: Feed: a new tab in Friends where you and your friends share what you cooked, with words, up to 4 photos or a recipe
One React button with 16 reactions to choose from; each post shows its top reactions and how many in all
Comment on friends' posts and get an alert when someone comments on yours; posts show how many comments they have
Edit your posts: change the words, remove or add photos, or change the recipe
Save a recipe from a friend's post straight into your recipes
Chat bubble styles stay on messages already sent; a newly chosen style only applies to new messages
Friends now see your avatar frame's animations everywhere
Smoother screen transitions, and a progress card while a post uploads

releases.notes: Groups, My fridge, Bambits, achievements, Cosmetics, a Shop, Mail and a season pass.
changes: Groups: chat and share recipes with up to 4 friends at once; anyone in a group can invite their own friends, and you can mute or leave it
My fridge (in Groceries): list what you have at home; recipes show what's missing and add it to your grocery list in one tap
Bambits: a daily gift that grows over 7 days, events and redeem codes; spend them in the new Shop
Achievements and daily quests: goals to reach as you cook, plan and share; pin up to 3 badges for friends to see
Season pass: a free reward track, with a frame you can only get this season
Cosmetics: earn avatar frames, chat bubble styles and collectibles; wear them in chats and groups, and send your collectibles as chat stickers
Recipes from videos and posts come in sorted and ready to check; Chinese recipes stay in Chinese, and hands-free cooking reads them aloud in Chinese
New Daily and Mail buttons: today's gift, quests and the season pass in one place, and gifts and news from Bambowl to claim

releases.notes: Groups, My fridge, Bambits, achievements, a Closet, a Shop, Mail and a season pass.
changes: Groups: chat and share recipes with up to 4 friends at once; anyone in a group can invite their own friends, and you can mute or leave it
My fridge (in Groceries): list what you have at home; recipes show what's missing and add it to your grocery list in one tap
Bambits: a daily gift that grows over 7 days, events and redeem codes; spend them in the new Shop
Achievements and daily quests: goals to reach as you cook, plan and share; pin up to 3 badges for friends to see
Season pass: a free reward track, with a frame you can only get this season
Closet: earn avatar frames, chat bubble styles and collectibles, and wear them in chats and groups
Recipes from videos and posts now come in sorted: ingredients, instructions, nutrition and tags, ready to check before you save
New Daily and Mail buttons: today's gift, quests and the season pass in one place, and gifts and news from Bambowl to claim

releases.notes: One-tap Import, recipes from Xiaohongshu, and a new Discover row.
changes: Import turns a link into a recipe ready to review, in one tap; Open the post only appears when a site hides a post from apps
Paste or share a Xiaohongshu note's link to save its recipe and photo
Discover has a new row, 5 ingredients or less: simple dishes that look as good as they taste
Captions and pasted text split more cleanly into ingredients, steps and notes, including recipes written in Chinese
Chat: the keyboard stays open after you send, and messages you've read no longer come back as unread
In Friends, tap someone's picture to see their profile, or their chat to open it; a neater unread count
When a new version is out, Bambowl offers it each time you open the app, until you update
Links shared with text right after them now open correctly

releases.notes: Bambowl has a new look: a crystal bowl with bamboo chopsticks.
changes: New app icon and a new logo inside the app
Matches your phone's themed icons on Android 13 and newer
Message alerts show the new bowl
Recipe times read more clearly: hours for long cooks, and a dash when a time isn't given

releases.notes: Recipes now show their nutrition, straight from the recipe site.
changes: Recipes from Discover and from recipe links keep the nutrition their site publishes
Saved recipes from recipe websites get their nutrition filled in by themselves
Calories, protein, carbs and fat, plus saturated fat, fibre, sugar and sodium
Each recipe says which site the numbers come from
Numbers are only ever copied from the site, never guessed or calculated
Edit any value yourself whenever you like

releases.notes: Cook hands-free: Bambowl reads each step aloud and moves on when you say "next".
changes: Tap the microphone in cooking mode to switch hands-free on
Say "next", "back", "repeat", "ingredients", "start timer" or "stop timer"
Finished timers are announced, so you hear them across the kitchen
Choose the reading voice and its speed in Preferences › Cooking voice
Optional "Hear me from further away" for a busy kitchen
It only listens while cooking mode is open, and nothing you say is recorded

releases.notes: Updates now download and install right inside the app, and you see what's new after each update.
changes: Tap Update and Bambowl downloads the new version itself, with a progress bar
Every download is checked before Android asks you to install it
If anything goes wrong, the download opens in your browser as before
After an update, a short "What's new" note appears once. Read it again any time in Help & about

releases.notes: Delete your account from the app, report people in Friends, and a refreshed Help & about.
changes: Delete my account in Account › Google account
Report a person from their profile or chat
AI tidy-up is now for approved accounts only
Updates now come from Zenith Gen Orbit

releases.notes: Cooking mode with timers, a smarter grocery list and What can I cook?
